metadata.title: Imphal to UKHRUL HILL Food Road Trip in Manipur I Juiciest Pineapple + Fiery Hot Chicken + Paratha
metadata.description:
After Imphal, we visited the town of Ukhrul, a captivating hill station in Manipur, in search of new flavours. 

Our gracious host, Ammo from Living Manipur guided us through this fascinating journey to this popular tourist destination that is primarily inhabited by the Tangkhul Naga community. 

Today's episode is all about this delightful food trip full of intriguing tales and sights. So do tune in to enjoy this interesting culinary experience. 


**Despite the ongoing ethnic conflict in Manipur, we made a conscious yet hard decision to proceed with our food video series from the state which was filmed between 30th Jan and 3rd Feb 2023. 

Our intention was to showcase the incredible warmth, love, kindness, camaraderie and enthusiasm we encountered during this immersive visit. 

It's essential to acknowledge the complexities the state is going through, but we firmly believe in highlighting the genuine goodness of the people whom we met during this wonderful journey. 

Throughout the five-day tour, we encountered a heartwarming display of hospitality, generosity and harmony. We want to reassure that our approach remains sensitive and respectful towards the ordeal being faced by the people of Manipur.**

For an immersive experience of Manipur do checkout Living Manipur's following handle:

https://www.livingmanipur.com/
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCbfm2U7gM3XRXbswWpDGpNQ
https://instagram.com/living.manipur


About the host:
https://anubhavsapra.com/

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/delhifoodwalks
Twitter: https://twitter.com/delhifoodwalks
Instagram: https://instagram.com/delhifoodwalks

https://instagram.com/iamrahulsingh.2
